data.name: Quest Slayer
data.detailed_description:
In Quest Slayer, you are a hunter whose job it is to complete Quests.
Track down and defeat powerful magical beasts or collect precious resources. Each hunt is a new challenge, forcing you to adapt your strategy, master your weapons, and learn the behavior of every creature you face.

Explore dangerous regions filled with dangerous beasts, hidden resources, and unpredictable encounters. Track your prey, study their weaknesses, and engage in intense battles that reward skill and timing.

Defeated beasts leave behind rare materials that can be gathered and crafted into stronger armor, upgraded weapons, and powerful new equipment. As you progress, you’ll unlock new combat abilities and spells, allowing you to customize your hunting style and become stronger with every successful quest.

Key Features

  • Beast Hunting                    - Track, fight, and slay unique beasts, each with distinct attacks and behaviors.

  • Multiple Weapon Classes - Choose your favorite weapon and upgrade it to it's final form, or just swap anytime to try something new.

  • Gear Progression               - Gather resources and monster parts to craft and upgrade gear.

  • Abilities & Spells                - Expand your combat options by unlocking new skills and magical powers. Some abilities are tied to specific weapon types, encouraging unique playstyles, while others are universal and can be used by any class. Using elemental attacks unlocks additional abilities within each element, allowing you to specialize, combine effects, and shape your own fighting style.
